title: Read a past run
description: Look at a run that already happened: its shape and outcome (summary), what its nodes and tasks produced (output), its event log including every tool call (log), or the code changes it left in its worktree (diff). Use it on a task's earlier runIds before retrying that task — the previous attempt is the cheapest information you will ever get about this problem.

runId.description: The run id, e.g. from a task's runIds.

what.description: summary (shape + outcome, default), output (what nodes and tasks produced), log (events and tool calls), diff (files the run changed).

taskId.description: For what: "diff" — the backlog task whose worktree to diff. Defaults to the task this run belongs to.

examples: read the run that failed on this task
what did the last attempt actually change
